offices.bio_summary: Attorney for tenants since 1980; created caltenantlaw.com in 1999; UC Berkeley and Loyola Law; admitted to all California courts and federal courts up through the U.S. Supreme Court; taught the Department of Real Estate landlord-tenant course; set up the caltenantlaw.com network of tenant lawyers. Came from poverty (trailer in Weymouth, Massachusetts), worked his way through school in many jobs, has faced eviction himself. Wrote the musical comedy Legal Ethics, invented the Facsuit, designed the website and work-from-home software; 20+ years in Idyllwild, operates MyIdy.net. Re-framed eviction as the Game Board and recorded the pre-consultation videos.
